The reports of the Banking Committees afford data in considerable bulk but of varying (1) _________ relating to the burden of debt on agriculturists in India and its nature and distribution which all refer to the period just before the depression. The immediate effect of the depression was (2) _________ to increase somewhat the money burden of the debt and very considerably its real burden. Another result of the depression (3) _____________ the worsening of the position of the smaller producer and the loss on his part of some proportion of rights in land. Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
options: output
variability
effects
reliability
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is "reliability"

Explanation:
☛ Context: The passage discusses Banking Committee reports providing data on agricultural debt. The phrase "data in considerable bulk but of varying _____" implies a contrast between quantity and quality. Reliability fits perfectly as it refers to the trustworthiness of data.
☛ Grammar: 'Varying' (adjective) modifies the noun reliability, emphasizing inconsistent accuracy.
☛ Exam Tip: While 'output' (quantity) and 'variability' (fluctuation) are plausible, they don’t address data quality. 'Effects' is irrelevant here.
☛ Example: "The experiment’s results showed varying reliability due to inconsistent methods." highlights the correct usage.
